context: Evaluates correct usage of the Vendure getSiteInfo API operation and the arrayToTree utility. Focuses on using getCommerceApi to access getSiteInfo, verifying that the flat Vendure collection list is converted to a hierarchical tree, and that each category's path is formatted as /${id}.

checklist.name: Use getCommerceApi + getSiteInfo
checklist.description: The solution calls `getCommerceApi()` and invokes the `getSiteInfo` operation, not a raw GraphQL fetch, to retrieve collection data.

checklist.name: Returns hierarchical categories
checklist.description: The categories returned are a nested tree structure (children nested within parents), not a flat array, demonstrating that arrayToTree was applied.

checklist.name: Path is /${id}
checklist.description: Each category object in the result has a `path` property formatted as `/${collection.id}`, not `/${slug}` or any other format.

checklist.name: Empty brands array
checklist.description: The function returns `brands: []` (empty array) alongside categories, as Vendure does not provide brand data.
